summary: osu! entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: osu!
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows osu! build; keep osu!(stable) noted for compatibility-sensitive replays

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official Windows client with documented input/display setup

primary.why: The official site currently presents a Windows 10+ x64 osu! download as the main route, while the older osu!(stable) Windows build is still linked separately. Windows PC gives the cleanest capture/input-latency route for this user-generated rhythm-game library.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Windows download and record build number, ruleset, beatmap ID/hash, input device, mods, score/rank, and whether the run uses the current client or older osu!(stable).

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge stable/lazer behavior blindly. Record exact client/build and beatmap metadata.
